tldr: The original-record gain is positive at every budget. Uniform certificates and a polynomial-time partial-replication procedure give an attained gain of at least \(\tfrac14(N^{-3/2}+m^{2/3}N^{-2})\), with upper certificates valid against every logging kernel and estimator. The proved uniform-bracket theorem gives \(G_N(m)=\Theta(N^{-4/3})\) on each fixed macroscopic band \(\delta N\le m\le N\), \(\delta\in(0,1]\). The exact laws are \(G_N(m)\sim32N^{-3/2}\) for \(m=o(\sqrt N)\) and \(G_N(N)\sim16C_A N^{-4/3}\). For \(0<\lambda<1\), the compulsory boundary chart has \(\tfrac14\lambda^{2/3}\le F_\partial^-(\lambda)\le F_\partial^+(\lambda)\le16C_A\). Sharp interior coefficients, the uniform submacroscopic joint order, and genuine crossover laws remain unresolved; no continuity or criticality is inferred from these brackets.
